metadata.name: Kimono Tools
metadata.description: A collection of APIs with endpoint access controls and live documentation.

apiCollection.name: Mawaqit
apiCollection.description: Find mosques and read their published prayer calendars.

operations.name: Search mosques
operations.description: Search by mosque or city name, or latitude and longitude. Closed mosques are excluded.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Mosque or city name. Use q or both lat and lon.

operations.response: JSON object with a mosques array. Each result has slug, name, and location.

operations.name: Prayer calendar
operations.description: Read the full published calendar and its mosque timezone. Data comes from the mosque page, not an official authenticated calendar API.

parameters.name: mosque
parameters.description: Mosque slug or https://mawaqit.net mosque URL.

operations.response: JSON object with mosque, timezone, calendar (12 monthly day maps), and fetchedAt. Times are local HH:mm values from the mosque.

operations.name: Prayer times
operations.description: Read six daily times for a date in the mosque timezone. Defaults to today at the mosque. No calculated prayer or night intervals.

parameters.name: mosque
parameters.description: Mosque slug or https://mawaqit.net mosque URL.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date in the current published calendar year.

operations.response: JSON object with mosque, date, timezone, times (name and local time), and fetchedAt. Includes Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.

apiCollection.name: RateMyProfessors
apiCollection.description: Find schools and read professor ratings.

operations.name: Search schools
operations.response: JSON object with a schools array. Each result has id, legacyId, name, city, state, numRatings, and avgRatingRounded.

operations.name: Professor ratings
operations.description: Read the best-matching professor at a school, with courses and tags.

parameters.name: school
parameters.description: Numeric school ID or RateMyProfessors school ID from Search schools.

parameters.name: ratings
parameters.description: true to include the 20 latest student ratings.

parameters.name: related
parameters.description: true to include related professors at the same school.

operations.response: JSON object with found. When found: id, name, department, school, avgRating, avgDifficulty, numRatings, wouldTakeAgainPercent, courses, tags, and optional ratings and relatedProfessors.
